title.en: christmas market in piazza xx settembre.
title.de: weihnachtsmarkt auf der piazza xx settembre.

line.en: natale a porta galliera opens today by the station, stalls for clothes, accessories and gifts. indicative hours 08:00 to 20:00, open until 6 january.
line.de: natale a porta galliera öffnet heute am bahnhof, buden für mode, accessoires und geschenke. richtzeiten 8 bis 20 uhr, bis 6. januar geöffnet.
line.tr: natale a porta galliera bugün istasyon yanında açılıyor; giysi, aksesuar ve hediyelik tezgâhlar. tahmini saatler 08:00 - 20:00, 6 ocak'a kadar açık.

sparks.why: Natale a Porta Galliera, from 19 Nov to 6 Jan in piazza xx settembre, 08:00 to 20:00 indicative (idealista, Bologna Christmas Markets 2026 guide).
